finding_before_runs.hermes_sends: tools/computer_use/cua_backend_input.py: click/double_click -> {element_index} (+ element_token from the last capture when the live schema lists element_token), scroll -> {element_index}, set_value -> {element_index, value}, drag -> {from_element, to_element}; coordinates as {x, y} (drag: from_x..to_y). NousResearch/hermes-agent main 54bc5e50 and kvnloo/hermes-agent main 54bc5e50 have tools/computer_use byte-identical to the stack base 0d60437a.
finding_before_runs.driver_accepts: trycua/cua#3873 (61f1c0ab, 2026-09-30, breaking): element_token is the only element target; element_index and snapshot_id removed from every action schema; unknown argument names refused at dispatch. Live tools/list of 0.32.0 (229b65b28): click, double_click, right_click, scroll, set_value, type_text advertise element_token and no element_index, additionalProperties=false; drag has no element form. 0.21.0 (Hermes' pinned release) advertises element_index + element_token + snapshot_id. trycua/cua main 989cc76c keeps token-only and adds the token pattern ^s[0-9a-f]{8}:[0-9]+$.
finding_before_runs.stale_side: Hermes (upstream and fork main) is stale relative to the Driver's current contract; the Driver contract is authority-preserving (snapshot-bound tokens, stale tokens refused). The fix belongs on the Hermes side.
finding_before_runs.fix: kvnloo/hermes-agent exp/stack-addr-20261002 70cfc7a5 (one hunk in CuaDriverBackend._action): when the live schema of the action advertises element_token but not element_index, send the current snapshot's token alone; with no token for that index refuse locally (code element_token_unavailable) - never a bare index, never a coordinate fallback. Drivers that advertise element_index keep their current wire shape.

tool_result_classes.source: Hermes' private state.db: every computer_use call paired with its result by tool_call_id (harness/extract.py)
tool_result_classes.token_unavailable: result code element_token_unavailable (Hermes-local refusal; no Driver call)
tool_result_classes.invalid_token: result contains an invalid-format, out-of-range or window-conflict token refusal (Driver)
tool_result_classes.other_error: any other ok=false, {error: ...} or non-JSON result
tool_result_classes.capture_ok: a capture result (or Hermes' byte-identical-result note)
tool_result_classes.ok: an action result with ok=true (the Driver accepted and dispatched it; 'ok' is NOT task success - only the oracle grades outcomes)
tool_result_classes.tool_error: any class other than capture_ok and ok
tool_result_classes.element_action: a click/double_click/right_click/middle_click/triple_click/scroll/set_value/drag call whose arguments carry an integer element/from_element/to_element

H1_contract.claim: With the fix, no element-addressing argument is refused by Driver 0.32.0.
H1_contract.gate: PASS iff after-arm measured runs have 0 addressing_refused results and every after-arm run has a summary. The before-arm count and the number of before-arm runs with a refusal are reported.

H2_element_reach.claim: Element actions reach Driver 0.32.0 and are dispatched.
H2_element_reach.gate: PASS iff >= 90% of after-arm measured runs that issue an element action have >= 1 element action with result ok. Before-arm element-action ok count reported (expected 0).

H3_task_success.claim: The fix raises oracle-verified task success on 0.32.0.
H3_task_success.metric: paired by (task, pair): after-only vs before-only passes
H3_task_success.gate: SUPPORTED per task iff after-only > before-only and the exact one-sided sign test p < 0.05. gtk3 is the primary test; browser is reported with the same test (the SMOKE browser task was hard for this model even on 0.21.0: 0-4/12 per arm). Pass counts with Wilson 95% CIs per cell.

H4_authority.claim: Hermes never sends a superseded or foreign token and never substitutes coordinates for a refused element.
H4_authority.gate: PASS iff after-arm stale_token == 0 and invalid_token == 0. token_unavailable local refusals are counted; by construction (unit-tested) each one makes no Driver call. Coordinate actions are counted per arm; any coordinate action is the model's own explicit choice (its arguments are recorded), never a Hermes substitution.

H5_tool_errors.claim: Tool-call errors per run, before vs after.
H5_tool_errors.report: tool calls, successful tool calls, tool errors (total, mean and median per run, runs with >= 1 error) and the result-class breakdown per arm and task; descriptive, no gate.

legacy.claim: The fix keeps the pinned 0.21.0 wire shape working.
legacy.gate: PASS iff 0 addressing_refused in the 6 legacy runs; pass counts descriptive (SMOKE 0.21.0 reference: gtk3 12/12, browser 0-4/12 per arm).
